featured.name: Official ATS Convoy - Diesel shortage
featured.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul diesel to Kingman Arizona! 👀  

> Coastline Mining has an urgent shortage of diesel to run all their mining equipment and request your assistance!

The event takes place on the **26th September 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P01ZlW49IXHTy)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/37508.1787823642.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul diesel  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Coastline Mining in Kingman.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/a4ebd34d-accb-4852-9da9-5633020befb0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **San Francisco** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/120680-official-ats-convoy-animal-transporting/)**!

Rendez-vous à 21h pour un nouveau convoi dans la bonne humeur et la bonne ambiance ! 🔥

On vous attend nombreux pour partager un maximum de kilomètres ensemble ! 💪🚛

Soyez à l’heure et prêts à prendre la route ! 🛣️ 

rdv
discord pour plus d'informationsd
today.rule:
🔴 AVANT LE DÉPART

Être présent au minimum 15 minutes avant le départ.

Faire le plein de carburant avant le rassemblement.

Vérifier l'état du camion et de la remorque.

Vérifier que le jeu est correctement configuré et à 
jour.

Préparer votre itinéraire avant le départ.

Rester sur le serveur vocal du convoi pendant toute la durée du trajet.

🚦 PENDANT LE CONVOI

Respecter impérativement l'ordre du convoi.

Garder une distance de sécurité suffisante avec le camion devant.

Ne pas doubler sans autorisation.

Ne pas dépasser le véhicule ouvreur.

Éviter les freinages brusques et les changements de voie inutiles.

Respecter le code de la route et les limitations de vitesse.
Ne pas faire de manœuvres dangereuses ou de zigzags.

Rester attentif aux indications des responsables du convoi.

📻 COMMUNICATION

Le vocal doit rester calme et organisé. ( CB : 20 )

Éviter de parler inutilement pendant les phases 
importantes du trajet.

Les responsables peuvent donner des instructions à tout moment.

En cas de problème, prévenir rapidement un responsable.

Si vous êtes déconnecté ou avez un problème technique, ne paniquez pas : prévenez le convoi dès que possible.

🛑 ARRÊTS / INCIDENTS

En cas d'accident, de panne ou de déconnexion :

Se mettre en sécurité.
Ne pas revenir brutalement sur la route.

Prévenir immédiatement un responsable.

Attendre les instructions avant de reprendre le convoi.

⚠️ Ne pas abandonner le convoi sans prévenir.

🟢 ARRIVÉE 

Garder sa position jusqu'à l'arrivée sur la zone prévue.

Attendre les instructions des responsables pour se garer.

Se garer proprement et respecter les autres participants.

Ne pas quitter immédiatement le convoi sans prévenir.

🤝 ESPRIT DU CONVOI

Le but est de passer un bon moment ensemble, dans le respect et la bonne humeur.
Respect • Sécurité • Discipline • Bonne ambiance

now.description:
# 🍂 Hello Autumn with GTLEGION — September

## 📖 About the Event

As summer comes to an end and a new season begins, **GTLEGION VTC** is pleased to invite the TruckersMP community to our special September event — **Hello Autumn with GTLEGION**!

This event is dedicated to welcoming the beginning of autumn with a large, organized community convoy through the beautiful roads of Europe.

Our goal is to bring together drivers from different VTCs and communities for an enjoyable, relaxed and well-organized convoy where everyone can enjoy the journey, meet other members of the TruckersMP community and celebrate the arrival of a new season together.


---

## 🍁 Event Concept

# **Fala, queridos jogadores!**

A Expresso Barramar realiza a segunda edição do comboio do Setembro Amarelo: Em defesa da vida. Vamos celebrar a vida, bem como a importância da valorização dela e da saúde mental, em um comboio bem planejado, para que haja uma melhor experiência possível em prol desta causa tão necessária!

**INFORMAÇÕES IMPORTANTES SOBRE O COMBOIO:**
- **Data:** Domingo, 13 de setembro de 2026
- **Servidor:** Simulation 1 | Reserva: [US] Simulation
- **Horário de encontro:** 19:00 BRT / 23:00 PT
- **Horário de partida:** 20:00 BRT / 00:00 PT
- [Veja a programação do evento de acordo com o horário de sua região!](https://notime.zone/P0Ol179lku5cz)
- **Rota:** Haverá desvios conforme marcação do mapa de rota anexado.
- **Local de partida:** Groningen, Holanda - Stokes
- **Local de chegada:** Stuttgart, Alemanha - BCP 
- **Poderá haver uma parada para abastecer, se necessário!**
- **Recomendamos que venha com o caminhão e reboques na cor amarelo (ou com detalhes na cor amarela)!** Traga-o sem danos e com tanque cheio! 

**EQUIPE DO EVENTO:**
- Líder organizador: [SenhorMicha](https://truckersmp.com/user/4267027)
- Co-líder: [Relâmpago Marquiinhos](https://truckersmp.com/user/1930536) e [AnjoDestruidor](https://truckersmp.com/user/482904)
- Apoio auxiliar: [Dark Star VTC](https://truckersmp.com/vtc/80463)

**DEMAIS INFORMAÇÕES:**
- Tenha bom senso e siga as regras do TruckersMP!
- Mantenha uma distância segura de cada integrante no comboio!
- Haverá call (EM PORTUGUÊS APENAS) e comunicação do evento em nosso servidor Discord, da [Expresso Barramar](https://discord.gg/9Xz5DPqDYf)


-----

_Por mais difícil e turbulento que seja o momento que você esteja atravessando, jamais desista da vida. Lembre-se de todas as pessoas que amam você, que se importam com você e que desejam, de coração, vê-lo bem. Mesmo nos momentos mais difíceis, sempre há alguém que deseja ver você superar essa tempestade._ 💛

_**Caso você precise de ajuda, ligue para o Centro de Valorização da Vida (CVV), pelo número 188.**_

upcoming.rule:
- **Event Rules for Participants:**

- The Event Staff are recognized as; “Drive Along | EF, Drive Along | ES, Drive Along | CC, Drive Along | Lead, Drive Along | Tail, Drive Along | GM" or similar.
- Free roaming is prohibited.
- Participants must haul a trailer.
- Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
- Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot you are required - to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
- Overtaking is prohibited.
- Cars are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.

- **Event Rules for Event Staff:**

- Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
- Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other - inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
- Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
- Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.
